_comment: Extended enemy notes beyond entities.json. Regenerate stats via npm run stats:generate.

defaults.loot: Rotting flesh and a loot bag — quality scales with your game stage.
combatTips: Headshots deal bonus damage and prevent some special death effects.
Variant color (feral, radiated, charged, infernal) indicates higher HP and threat.

zombie-cop.behavior: Leaves a toxic corpse explosion if killed without a headshot.
zombie-cop.loot: Rotting flesh, loot bag, police POI containers.
combatTips: Always prioritize headshots — the corpse blast can wipe a room.
Clear from range in police stations and blood moon hordes.

zombie-screamer.behavior: Screams when alerted and calls additional zombies to your location.
combatTips: Kill silently or from stealth before it screams.
Heat-map spawns — treat as priority target during base defense.

zombie-demolition.behavior: Smashes player-placed blocks and can breach bases quickly.
combatTips: Focus fire immediately — do not let it reach your walls.
Common on late blood moons and city POIs.

zombie-crawler.behavior: Stays low, harder to headshot, can slip under some defenses.
combatTips: Aim lower than standing walkers.
Watch floor-level gaps in spike traps and fences.

zombie-vulture.behavior: Flies and dive-bombs players; common on rooftops and blood moons.
combatTips: Clear rooftops before looting POI upper floors.
Low HP but annoying in groups — bring a rifle or bow.

zombie-rancher.behavior: Can summon insect swarms when damaged in the desert.
combatTips: Finish quickly to reduce swarm uptime.
Pairs with Insect Swarm — clear both in desert POIs.

insect-swarm.behavior: Flying swarm spawned by rancher zombies; low HP but fast.
insect-swarm.loot: Minimal — nuisance spawn, not a loot source.
combatTips: Use melee with wide swings or any ranged splash.
Usually appears alongside Zombie Rancher.

zombie-wight.behavior: Elite feral-tier walker that runs day and night.
combatTips: Treat as a mini-boss — high HP and speed.
Common in wasteland, military POIs, and late blood moons.

mutated-zombie.behavior: Large bloated mutant — primary heavy walker in the wasteland.
combatTips: High HP pool — armor-piercing weapons help.
Radiated and infernal variants appear at high game stage.

zombie-bear.behavior: Massive undead bear boss with extreme HP.
zombie-bear.loot: Rotting flesh, bear loot, boss-tier rewards.
combatTips: Boss encounter — bring medical supplies and high-tier weapons.
Found in wasteland and special POIs.

zombie-grace.behavior: Giant mutated boar boss at farm POIs (Bob's Boars, Carl's Corn, Hogzilla Ranch).
zombie-grace.loot: Boss loot bag, farm POI rewards.
combatTips: POI clear boss — kiting and ranged damage recommended.
Quest and tier rewards scale with game stage.

zombie-chuck.behavior: Heavy snow-biome zombie with high base HP.
combatTips: Snow biome specialist — expect feral+ variants earlier than forest walkers.

zombie-dog.behavior: Fast pack hunter — closes distance quickly.
combatTips: Dangerous at night in snow and wasteland.
Listen for growls before entering cities.

zombie-spider.behavior: Climbs walls and moves faster at night.
combatTips: Can scale player walls — overhangs and spikes help.
More common outdoors after dark.

zombie-burnt.behavior: Fire-damaged walker common in Burnt Forest.
combatTips: Often mixed with feral variants in burnt POIs.
Fire resistance perks reduce environmental stack damage nearby.

zombie-biker.behavior: Tougher than standard walkers; common mini-boss in garages and bars.
combatTips: Expect in POI boss rooms and garage clears.
Higher HP than standard tier-1 walkers.
